v0.heading: How Shorts works
v0.bullet1: Only your own team can see your Shorts. To share a clip outside your team, an adult has to say yes first.
v0.bullet2: A parent or guardian has to say yes before you can upload a Shorts yourself.
v0.bullet3: Something feel off about a Shorts? Report it and it disappears immediately for the whole team, while an adult takes a look.
v0.bullet4: You can always delete your own Shorts, whenever you want.

v1.consentPartSelfVerify: You need to verify your email or phone number.
v1.consentPart: A parent or guardian needs to say yes.
v1.joinPart: Your team's captain needs to approve that you joined the team.
v1.bothPendingSuffix: As soon as both are done, we'll unlock the Shorts tab.
v1.joinPendingSuffix: As soon as the captain approves, we'll unlock the Shorts tab.
v1.consentPendingSuffix: As soon as that's done, we'll unlock the Shorts tab.
v1.pausedBody: A parent or guardian has withdrawn approval. Talk to your coach if you have questions.

v2.heading: Shorts 🎬
v2.loadError: Couldn't load Shorts. Check your connection.
v2.emptySub: Be the first to share a Shorts with your team!
v2.showMoreError: Couldn't load more Shorts. Try again.
v2.uploadLockedToast: Still waiting for approval before you can upload.
v2.consentRevokedToast: We still need approval before you can upload. We'll refresh the page for you.
v2.reportRateLimitedToast: You've reported quite a few things lately. Wait a little while before reporting again.
v2.blockedToast: You'll no longer see Shorts or messages from {{screenName}}.

v9.heading: Why are you reporting this video?
v9.reasonAppearsWithoutConsent: I'm in this video and didn't want to be

v10.heading: Thanks for telling us.
v10.body: The video is now hidden for the whole team, including you. No one will know it was you who reported it.
v10.bodySecondary: An adult will find out about this, but we can't promise exactly when the video will be reviewed.
v10.followUp: Do you also want to stop seeing Shorts and messages from this person?

v11.heading: Delete this Shorts video?
v11.body: The video disappears permanently for the whole team — this can't be undone.

v4.heading: Pick or record a Shorts
v4.sub: The video can be up to {{maxSeconds}} seconds long.
v4.tooLong: The video is too long — max {{maxSeconds}} seconds. Try another one!
v4.wrongFormat: That file type doesn't work here. Try a video from the camera or gallery.
v4.unreadable: Couldn't read the video. Try another one.
v4.permission: We need your permission for this. Try again, or choose the other option.

v5.heading: Caption & challenge
v5.taggedHelper: {{screenName}} will see the challenge right away — in the team chat and on the Team tab.
v5.captionRejected: The caption couldn't be saved — it contained words that don't work here. Try rewriting it! ✍️
v5.rateLimited: You're uploading Shorts a bit fast right now. Wait a little while and it'll work again.
v5.taggedPlayerGone: That player is no longer on the team. Choose someone else, or no one.
v5.uploadStalled: The upload stalled. Finish writing — we'll try again when you send.

v6.heading: Uploading your Shorts…
v6.sub: Don't leave the app — it'll only take a moment.
v6.retryFailure: Something went wrong with the upload. We'll try again from the start.
v6.giveUp: The upload didn't succeed this time. Check your connection and try again.
v6.captionRejected: That caption wasn't allowed. Change it and try again.
v6.uploadExpired: The clip expired before it was saved. Pick it again and we'll upload it fresh.

v7.heading: Your Shorts is up! 🎉
v7.sub: Your team can see it now.

clipShareSheet.bodyNone: Right now your videos are only visible to your team. To share them with other floorball players, a parent has to say yes first.
clipShareSheet.bodyPending: We've sent an email. As soon as they say yes you can start sharing. It might take a day or two.
clipShareSheet.bodyOn: Other floorball players can see the video, your screen name and your avatar. They never see your real name, your team or where you train.
clipShareSheet.bodyShared: This video is visible outside your team right now. You can stop sharing whenever you like — it disappears straight away.
clipShareSheet.errorGeneric: That didn't work just now. Try again in a moment.
clipShareSheet.errorRevoked: Sharing is switched off for your account right now. Ask your parent.
clipShareSheet.errorTooSoon: You just asked. Wait a little while and try again.
